Package edu.scu.phantommaze.model

Class Game

java.lang.Object
edu.scu.phantommaze.model.Game
public class Game extends Object
Root of the game model. Owns the map, the player, the enemies and the rules that connect them: shooting, power-ups, getting caught, and running out of health.

  • Constructor Details

    • Game

      public Game(GameMap map, Difficulty difficulty)
      Creates a game on a map.
      Parameters:
      map - the level map; it must contain a ghost pen (G) with a door (-)
      difficulty - enemy speed, power-up length and other tuning
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the map has no pen or no pen door

    • threatLevel

      public double threatLevel(Enemy e)
      How strongly the "sixth sense" should warn about an enemy. Only enemies that can hurt the player count (not frightened ones, not ones in the pen), measured by walking distance so an enemy on the other side of a wall does not set it off.
      Parameters:
      e - the enemy
      Returns:
      0 (no warning) up to almost 1 (right next to the player)

    • threatAngle

      public double threatAngle(Enemy e)
      Which way the "sixth sense" should point for an enemy. If nothing blocks the view, that is straight at the enemy. Otherwise it follows the enemy's walk toward the player and points at the first spot the player can see - usually the corner the enemy will come around.
      Parameters:
      e - the enemy
      Returns:
      radians like relativeAngle(edu.scu.phantommaze.model.Enemy): 0 = straight ahead, positive = to the right
